# graph-manager: the Reviewers page (list, add, edit, enable/disable, delete, reset) ## What to build Already in the codebase (earlier slice): graph-manager's server stores one global list of reviewers and serves (behind login): - `GET /api/reviewers` → `{ reviewers: Reviewer[], builtinIds: ["code", "tester"], providers: ["claude","codex","opencode","qwen","fake"], file: "/reviewers.json" }`, where `Reviewer = { id, type: "diff"|"tester", name, enabled, instructions, repoFile, provider?, model?, files?: string[], blockAt: "major"|"blocker"|"never" }`. - `POST /api/reviewers` (create; 201 `{ reviewer }`; `repoFile` defaults to `_REVIEW.md` when empty), `PUT /api/reviewers/:id` (full reviewer, id unchanged; 200 `{ reviewer }`), `DELETE /api/reviewers/:id` (204; 400 for `tester`), `POST /api/reviewers/reset/:id` (`code`/`tester`: built-in instructions back; 200 `{ reviewer }`). Validation errors are 400 `{ error: ": " }` (e.g. `repoFile: "REVIEW.md" is already used by reviewer "code"`). - Every run started from graph-manager uses the enabled reviewers of this list. This slice adds the **Reviewers** page to the web UI (spec `docs/prd/ui-reviewers.md`, "graph-manager: Reviewers page", user stories 1-5; KAN-87): - A nav item **Reviewers** between Workspaces and Settings, the route `/reviewers`, the keyboard chord `g v`, and a "Reviewers" entry in the Ctrl K palette's Pages group. - A note at the top: "Used by every run started from graph-manager. Runs already going keep the reviewers they started with." - A list, one row per reviewer: an enable switch, the name, the type (`diff` / `live tester`), the provider/model ("run default" when empty), `blockAt` ("blocks at major" / "blocks at blocker" / "never blocks"), Edit and Delete buttons (no Delete for `tester`). - **Add reviewer** button and an Edit drawer with: name, id (editable only when adding; fixed after create), instructions (large monospace textarea), repo file (prefilled `_REVIEW.md` from the id while the user has not typed in it, hint "Optional file at the repo root with this repo's own rules for this reviewer"), provider (select: "run default" + providers), model (text, placeholder "run default"), files (textarea, one glob per line, hint "Only these changed files; ! excludes. Empty: every file"), block at (Segmented: major / blocker / never). A new reviewer is always `type: "diff"` (only one tester exists). - **Reset to built-in** button in the drawer for `code` and `tester` (with a confirm), calling the reset route. - Server errors show in a red box in the drawer (the drawer stays open); success closes it with a toast ("Saved Security", "Added Security", "Deleted Security"). ## Context: files to read before implementing - `apps/graph-manager/src/web/Shell.tsx`: - line 28 `const CHORD: Record = { r: "/runs", t: "/terminals", w: "/workspaces", s: "/settings" };` — add `v: "/reviewers"`; - lines 42-53 `NavItem`; lines 154-184 the nav links (Runs, Terminals, Workspaces, Settings) — insert Reviewers between Workspaces and Settings. - `apps/graph-manager/src/web/App.tsx` lines 64-75 the `` — add `} />` (one additive line + import). - `apps/graph-manager/src/web/CommandPalette.tsx` lines 50-56 the Pages items — add `{ id: "p:reviewers", group: "Pages", icon: "review", label: "Reviewers", secondary: "page", to: "/reviewers" }`. - `apps/graph-manager/src/web/ui/Icon.tsx` lines 1-27 `IconName` and the `PATHS` map (16×16 stroke icons, `currentColor`) — add a `review` icon (e.g. a magnifier over a check: `<>`). - `apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/Settings.tsx` (196 lines) — page layout (`
`, header with `

light and dark come from tokens, never hard-coded colors. - Tests: `apps/graph-manager/src/web/Settings.test.tsx` (lines 1-80: `vi.stubGlobal("matchMedia")`, a `fetch` mock routing URLs, `OverviewProvider` + `ToastProvider` + router), `apps/graph-manager/src/web/Shell.test.tsx` (nav order and chords), `apps/graph-manager/src/web/keys.test.tsx`. - `TESTING.md` "graph-manager UI checklist" step 11 (keyboard: `g r`, `g t`, `g w`, `g s`) — add `g v` → `/reviewers` there, and a short "### Reviewers" paragraph under "## graph-manager" describing the page and the API. ## Patterns to follow - Web imports have no `.js` suffix (`import { api } from "../api";`). - `data-testid` on everything a test touches: `page-reviewers`, `reviewer-row-`, `reviewer-enabled-`, `reviewer-edit-`, `reviewer-delete-`, `reviewer-add`, `reviewer-drawer`, `reviewer-save`, `reviewer-reset`, `reviewer-error`. - The enable switch is ``; toggling sends `PUT /api/reviewers/:id` with the full reviewer and `enabled` flipped, optimistic, rolled back with an error toast on failure. - Under 900 px the rows become two-line cards and the drawer is full width (the `Drawer` already is); `document.documentElement.scrollWidth - innerWidth` must stay 0 at 800 px. ## Step-by-step tasks ### CREATE `apps/graph-manager/src/web/reviewers.ts` (pure helpers, node-env tests) - `export interface Reviewer { … }` (as above) and `export interface ReviewersResponse { reviewers: Reviewer[]; builtinIds: string[]; providers: string[]; file: string }`. - `export const repoFileFor = (id: string): string => \`${id.toUpperCase().replaceAll("-", "_") || "NAME"}_REVIEW.md\`;` - `export const idFromName = (name: string): string` — lowercase, non `[a-z0-9]` runs → `-`, trimmed of `-`, max 32 (prefills the id while adding). - `export function toForm(r?: Reviewer): ReviewerForm` and `export function fromForm(f: ReviewerForm, isNew: boolean): Reviewer` — `files` textarea ↔ array (split lines, trim, drop empty; empty → omit `files`), empty provider/model → omitted, `type` `"diff"` for new ones. - `export const providerLabel = (r: Reviewer): string` → `"run default"` or `provider` / `provider · model` / `run default · model`. - `export const blockLabel = { major: "blocks at major", blocker: "blocks at blocker", never: "never blocks" }`. ### CREATE `apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/Reviewers.tsx` and `Reviewers.css` - `export default function Reviewers()`: loads `GET /api/reviewers` on mount (skeleton rows while loading, `SkeletonRows` from `../ui`), keeps `{ reviewers, providers, builtinIds }` in state, reloads after every write. - Header: `

`, the note (exact text above) and `{file}`, the **Add reviewer** primary button (`reviewer-add`). - Rows as described; `tester` row shows type "live tester" and no Delete button; Delete opens `ConfirmDialog` "Delete ?" with body "Runs started from now on won't run this reviewer." and confirm "Delete". - `ReviewerDrawer({ open, reviewer?, providers, builtin, onClose, onSaved })` in the same file or `ReviewerDrawer.tsx`: - Fields as listed (labels: Name, Id, Instructions, Repo file, Provider, Model, Files, Block at). Id input `disabled` when editing; while adding, the id follows `idFromName(name)` until the user edits the id, and the repo file follows `repoFileFor(id)` until the user edits it. - Instructions: `
